item.title: Skiers rescued from gondola on Gore Mountain
item.description: New York State Police and New York State Department of Environmental Conservation forest rangers responded to Gore Mountain on Wednesday afternoon to conduct a rescue for numerous skiers stranded on the resort's Northwoods gondola.

item.title: Outreach program aids homeless community during frigid Central New York temperatures
item.description: In My Father's Kitchen is providing services to 20 chronically homeless individuals living outdoors in Central New York, encouraging them to transition into housing or indoor facilities, while providing small supplies to help them stay warm.

item.title: Over 450,000 Jeep and Ram model vehicles recalled
item.description: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) just announced that Chrysler is recalling several models totaling more than 450,000 vehicles.

item.title: Stricter driver violation point system takes effect Feb. 16
item.description: New York State's DMV is tightening its point system, with tougher penalties and a lower threshold for license suspension, making it easier for drivers to lose their license.

item.title: TIMELINE: Deadly stolen minivan crash on Erie Boulevard West in Syracuse
item.description: A stolen minivan fleeing from a traffic stop crashed into a telephone pole on Erie Boulevard West, resulting in the death of the driver and minor injuries to the passenger.

item.title: One injured after South Avenue apartment fire in Syracuse
item.description: One person was injured in a fire that broke out in an apartment on South Avenue in Syracuse on Feb. 4, which was determined to be accidental and caused by cooking.

item.title: Local business reflects on 'mystery order' received unknowingly from Chobani as progress continues on the Rome plant
item.description: Olney Flowers in Rome, NY received an order for a flower delivery from an event planner, which turned out to be for the announcement of Chobani's manufacturing facility to be built in Rome, and progress is being made at the site.

item.title: 16-year-old arrested for attempted robbery in Fairmount Wegman's parking lot
item.description: A 16-year-old was taken into custody by Geddes Police after attempting to rob a 17-year-old in the parking lot of Wegman's in Fairmount.
